defects.title: Relay-bus reliability is a blocking dependency for runtime lifecycle adapters
evidence: docs/plans/soulfactory-nostr-agent-lifecycle-2026-05-14.md Work Item 4 requires scoped filters, EOSE, reconnect/backoff, AUTH, CLOSED, OK enforcement, and dedupe before runtime/lifecycle work depends on the bus.
defects.recommended_fix: Complete relay_bus.go and its isolated tests before wiring runtime adapters or bridge execution paths.

defects.title: Runtime bridges may drift without shared fixtures
evidence: The plan identifies bridge payload drift as a risk and requires docs/soulfactory-runtime-control.md before bridge implementation.
defects.recommended_fix: Promote the documented shared example into reusable Go and TypeScript contract fixtures when implementation begins.

defects.title: External REST-only deployment paths would violate the lifecycle contract
evidence: The plan requires no REST external agent control plane and says REST-only deploy paths must be replaced or deferred behind event-native Bahia control-plane events.
defects.recommended_fix: During implementation, audit deployment/control paths and file a follow-up issue if any required external path remains REST-only.
